author: Terry Pratchett
title: Good Omens
reason: Apocalypse comedy with an angel and a demon being besties? Yes please. I need a laugh and some existential crisis at the same time.
notes: Utter chaos in the best way possible. The writing is so British it hurts (in a good way). Might be illegal to read this in silence.

author: Yuval Noah Harari
title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
reason: Everyone keeps quoting this book like it’s the Bible of modern history. I wanna see if I'm actually just a glorified monkey.
notes: Some chapters made me question my entire existence. Others made me feel like I accidentally joined a TED Talk halfway through.

author: Madeline Miller
title: The Song of Achilles
reason: Gay Greek tragedy? Inject it straight into my veins. Everyone says this book emotionally destroys you in a beautiful way.
notes: I'm not saying I cried, but I did have to stare at a wall for 20 minutes afterward. 10/10 would suffer again.

author: Andy Weir
title: Project Hail Mary
reason: I want a sci-fi book that feels smart but also silly. Apparently this one has science, jokes, AND potentially space friendship.

author: Michelle Zauner
title: Crying in H Mart
reason: Asian mother-daughter memoir + food = guaranteed emotional damage. Gonna cry and then order Korean food.
notes: Reading this while hungry was a mistake. Reading this while emotionally stable was also a mistake.

author: Erin Morgenstern
title: The Night Circus
reason: Magical circus that only opens at night? Sounds like vibes. I want atmosphere, not logic.
notes: The plot? Unsure. The vibe? Immaculate. I felt like I was floating in a dream made of black velvet and cinnamon.

author: Douglas Adams
title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
reason: I want to understand why 42 is funny. Also, I've been told this book unlocks a secret level of sarcasm.
notes: Half of it felt like nonsense, but like, the *good* kind of nonsense. Might adopt ‘Don’t Panic’ as my new life motto.

author: Donna Tartt
title: The Secret History
reason: Dark academia murder book. I want to feel like a pretentious university student with a smoking addiction.
notes: These people need therapy and maybe prison. Couldn’t stop reading.
